Fees & Charges Bylaw No. 1958, 2014 (Consolidated for Convenience through Amendment A20)
SCHEDULE “G” (Bylaw 1958-A19)
ELECTRICAL UTILITY FEES AND CHARGES 1. Residential Service
(a) Basic minimum service charge, per month $24.84
plus (b) Electrical usage charge, per kWh $0.15516
2. Commercial/Industrial/Institutional Service
(a) Basic minimum service charge, per month $29.80
plus (b) Electrical usage charge for the first 200,000 KWh used in a
two-month billing period, per kWh $0.15134
plus usage in excess of 200,000 kWh in a two-month billing
period, per kWh $0.11231
3. Seasonal Loads (minimum period of service is three months)
(a) Basic minimum service charge, per month $29.80
plus (b) Electrical usage charge, per kWh $0.15134
4. Unmetered Service
Rate based on estimated consumption by written agreement 5. Service Charges
(a) New account – includes initial meter reading $41.66
(b) Additional meter reading outside normal billing cycle
(not applicable to final billed account or if water meter reading charge applies) $30.80
(c) Disconnection or reconnection of existing service $61.31
(d) New service installation or upgrading of existing service
i) Basic single phase overhead connection: 200 amp service $858.27
400 amp service $2,084.22
ii) Basic single phase underground connection: 200 amp service $1,508.35
400 amp service $2,734.29
iii) All other services greater than 400 amps Actual Cost
iv) Three phase overhead or underground Actual Cost
(e) Temporary construction service 100 amps or less $306.55

Fees & Charges Bylaw No. 1958, 2014 (Consolidated for Convenience through Amendment A20)
6. Meter Checking
Meter removal charge and “in-house” inspection Administration charge $89.26
plus
any applicable inspection fees charged by Measurement Canada or its authorized service
provider 7. Digital Non-Radio Meter (if applicable)
(a) Setup charge $199.82
(b) Manual read charge, per reading $30.80
